title: 🏆 Test Practice 3
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 TEST-1 paper (Sound & Light)

activities.title: Classify the Words
activities.prompt: Catch each word and send it to its family!

scenes.t: Sound and light are important in our daily lives.
Sound happens when something moves back and forth. This movement makes waves that travel through the air to our ears.
Some sounds are loud, like music at a party, and some are quiet, like a soft knock on the door.
Light helps us see everything around us. The sun gives us natural light during the day.
At night, we use lamps and phones to give us light. Light can be strong or weak.
When light shines on an object, we can see its shape and color. Without sound and light, it would be hard to see clearly or move safely.

o: When something moves back and forth

items.q: Which is a loud sound from the text?
What does light help us do?
What are the two sources of light in the text?
What would be difficult without sound and light?
o: To see clearly and move safely

items.q: This is a language you learn at school. People in England speak it. (E _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
In this subject you learn about animals, plants and nature. (S _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
When you like something very much, you think it is... (E _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
When you have a lot to do, you are... (B _ _ _)
A person who helps the police to catch thieves. (D _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
Put in order: perfectly - do - I - homework - my - always
o: I always do my homework perfectly.
I do always my homework perfectly.
Always I my homework do perfectly.

items.q: Put in order: visits - grandparents - his - usually - on - Mondays - he
o: He usually visits his grandparents on Mondays.
He visits usually his grandparents on Mondays.
Usually he on Mondays visits his grandparents.

items.q: Put in order: cake - baking - delicious - sister - a - my - is
o: My sister is baking a delicious cake.
My sister baking is a delicious cake.
A delicious cake my sister is baking is.

items.q: Put in order: movies - action - the - we - enjoy - on - TV - watching
o: We enjoy watching action movies on TV.
We enjoy to watch action movies on TV.
Watching action movies we enjoy on TV is.

items.q: Put in order: is - girl - the - who's - purple - a - skirt - Helen - wearing
o: Helen is the girl who's wearing a purple skirt.
Helen is the girl who's a purple skirt wearing.
The girl who's wearing a purple skirt Helen.
